name: Lucky Janitor
source:
Lucky Janitor is a short (somewhat kinetic) visual novel. It tells the story of a janitor who suddenly finds himself in surprising situations involving the members of the school. His workplace.

[From [url=https://justrean.itch.io/luckyjanitor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《幸运的看门人》是一部简短的（有点动态的）视觉小说。它讲述了一名看门人突然发现自己陷入了涉及学校成员的令人惊讶的境地的故事。他的工作场所。

[来自[url=https://justrean.itch.io/luckyjanitor]Itch.io[/url]]
